parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the details—sorry for the delay your operations team is experiencing. We understand that, after the most recent release, the analytics dashboard now takes about 30–45 seconds to load (previously under 5 seconds) and it eventually loads, but it’s slowing daily planning for 25 users.

To help engineering pinpoint what changed and where the extra time is coming from, could you share the following minimum info:
1) The date/time of the last release (and roughly when you first noticed the slowdown).
2) Whether this occurs for all affected users or only some (and if it varies by browser/region).
3) Any observations from a slow-load session—e.g., does it hang on a specific step, and are there any console errors or network/API calls you can see in your browser’s dev tools.

If you already have screenshots or a short screen recording of a slow load (showing the timestamp or loading state), that would be very helpful.

We’ll use the info above to investigate the performance regression in the next working cycle and follow up with what we find and any recommended mitigations.
